newTerms.captain of the temple guards: capitán de los guardias del templo

forcedChoices.reason: Plain self-identification; «Yo soy» alone can read as the divine name, which the English does not state here.
"Master" is fixed as «Maestro», so "Teacher" needs a second word to keep two titles.
Jesus speaks to the armed band as a group.
«criminal desesperado» reads as "hopeless" in Spanish; the English means a reckless, dangerous criminal.
«abrigo» is a modern overcoat; the garment is a body covering, and "cloak" (3.10) takes «manto».
